title: Maximum lengths
why: Checks the upper limits of the string and numeric columns: a 10-character passport number, a 50-character name and a 3-digit age. Off-by-one length checks, truncation and column overflow show up here.

steps.does: Create the passenger with a 10-character passport number, a 50-character name and age 120, then read it back.

expect: The record is saved and read back with PassportNumber exactly 10 characters, Name exactly 50 characters and Age 120, with nothing truncated or rejected. An 11th character in the passport or 51st in the name would be rejected.
